685.excerpt: Punk 685 was burned by mistake on March 24, 2023 while attempting to wrap the token into an ERC721 using the Wrappedpunks contract. No proxy wallet was designated during Step 2.

2317.excerpt: Punk 2317 was purchased on July 12, 2021 for 18.93 Eth by ROBNESS and then immediately burned as performance art piece titled HOW TO BURN A CRYPTOPUNK AND NOT FEEL A THING.......A TUTORIAL for his recurring #trashday event.

2761.excerpt: Punk 2761 was burned accidentally on December 17, 2021 due to pasting a malformed wallet address in the transfer field.

2838.excerpt: In 2018 ZKM | Center for Art and Media Karlsruhe acquired 4 CryptoPunks for their permanent collection.

3493.excerpt: Punk 3493 was burned accidentally during an attempted move on April 19, 2019 becoming the first punk ever to be burned a few months shy of the 2 year mint anniversary.

3808.excerpt: Punk 3808 was accidentally burned on March 3, 2021 when a partial address was pasted into the transfer field.

5041.excerpt: Punk 5041 was accidentally burned on June 4, 2023 during a trade when a transaction ID was mistakenly copy and pasted into the transfer to field rather than the wallet address of the intended recipient.

5237.excerpt: Punk 5237 was purchased on June 13th, 2023 for 55.95 ETH and burned on August 10th, 2023 along with several other high value NFTs including BAYC, MAYC and others. The owner, nd4.eth had burned 2500 ETH in the previous days.

5449.excerpt: In 2018 ZKM | Center for Art and Media Karlsruhe acquired 4 CryptoPunks for their permanent collection.

7755.excerpt: The second punk ever burned, 7755, was purchased the previous day for 5.49 ETH by well known anon collector 0xb1 with the expressed intention of burning it. This was the lowest priced Cryptopunk available at the time.

8611.excerpt: Punk 8611 was purchased for 54.49 Eth with funds raised through a crowdfunding campaign with the specific intention of burning it and inscribing a copy of it on the Bitcoin blockchain.

9146.excerpt: Punk 9146 was purchased for 53.95 Eth with funds raised through a crowdfunding campaign with the specific intention of burning it and inscribing a copy of it on the Bitcoin blockchain.

110.excerpt: Shortly after their donation of #305 to ICA Miami, Yuga Labs (under Natalie Stone's stewardship) donated #110 to Center Pompidou in Paris.

305.excerpt: Shortly after the CryptoPunks IP was acquired by Yuga Labs in 2022, they announced the CryptoPunks Legacy Project to further establish CryptoPunks within the contemporary art world, and museum donations were a primary focus.

1286.excerpt: In early 2018 Germany's ZKM was the first major art institution to acquire CryptoPunks for it's collection. Punks #2554, #1286, #5449, and #2838 were purchased by museum employee Daniel Heiss.
